metadata.description: Pre-built goal-based workflows that chain multiple skills in sequence for common development objectives.

workflows.name: Full Code Review
workflows.description: Comprehensive 6-phase code review covering context, quality, security, performance, testing, and final report.
workflows.trigger: When you need a thorough review before merging a feature branch or preparing a release.

workflows.name: Security Audit
workflows.description: Ordered local security audit: scope and detect with scanner receipts, triage reachability, optionally remediate with user approval, re-scan with the same detector, independently verify, then close. Authentication and licensing remain in the sequence without duplicating their procedures.
workflows.trigger: Before a production release, compliance audit, or after a security incident.

workflows.name: New Project Setup
workflows.description: Initialize a new project with proper structure, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and containerization.
workflows.trigger: When starting a new project or microservice from scratch.

workflows.name: API Development
workflows.description: Design, build, test, and document an API from requirements to deployment.
workflows.trigger: When designing and implementing a new API or major API revision.

workflows.name: Release Preparation
workflows.description: Prepare a release with full review, version bump, changelog, testing, and documentation updates.
workflows.trigger: When preparing a version release for staging or production.

workflows.name: Legacy Modernization
workflows.description: Assess, plan, and execute a legacy codebase modernization using strangler fig and incremental refactoring.
workflows.trigger: When modernizing a legacy system or migrating to a new architecture.

workflows.name: AI Agent Pipeline
workflows.description: Build an AI agent or RAG system from design through implementation and evaluation.
workflows.trigger: When building an AI agent, RAG pipeline, or LLM-powered application.

workflows.name: Compliance Assessment
workflows.description: Full compliance review across applicable regulatory frameworks with gap analysis and remediation plan.
workflows.trigger: When preparing for an audit, onboarding an enterprise client, or reviewing regulatory readiness.

workflows.name: Test Coverage Boost
workflows.description: Systematically increase test coverage from unit tests through E2E with mutation testing validation.
workflows.trigger: When test coverage is below target or test quality is uncertain.

workflows.name: Production Readiness
workflows.description: Validate that a system is ready for production with observability, security, performance, and resilience checks.
workflows.trigger: Before deploying a new service to production for the first time.

workflows.name: Cross-Model Orchestration
workflows.description: Coordinate multiple AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Copilot) in a structured workflow with planning, QA review, implementation, and verification phases.
workflows.trigger: When a complex task benefits from using multiple AI models for different phases (planning, review, implementation, verification).

workflows.name: Research-Plan-Implement (RPI)
workflows.description: Structured RPI workflow with GO/NO-GO gates between research, planning, and implementation phases, producing persistent artifact files.
workflows.trigger: When starting a feature that requires upfront research, multi-perspective planning, and phased implementation with formal approval gates.

workflows.name: Token Optimization
workflows.description: Audit and optimize token consumption across tool calls, context window usage, and prompt design to reduce cost and maximize effective context.
workflows.trigger: When hitting context limits frequently, when token costs are too high, or when optimizing a workflow for efficiency.

workflows.name: Intent-Based Code Review
workflows.description: Review AI-generated code by verifying acceptance criteria pass/fail status rather than line-by-line inspection. Detailed review triggered only for failed criteria.
workflows.trigger: When reviewing AI-generated code at scale, when acceptance criteria are well-defined, or when PR volume exceeds human review capacity.

workflows.name: Adversarial Code Review
workflows.description: Extend standard or intent-based review with an adversarial breaker agent that actively tries to break the implementation through edge cases, injection attacks, and contract violations.
workflows.trigger: When reviewing high-stakes changes (security, payments, data integrity) that warrant independent adversarial testing before merge.

workflows.name: Competitive Implementation
workflows.description: Run multiple agents in parallel on the same task, score candidates objectively (test passage, diff size, dependencies, lint, complexity), and select the best implementation.
workflows.trigger: When a high-value or high-risk change justifies running multiple agent attempts to select the best implementation.

workflows.name: Progressive Delivery
workflows.description: Deploy with canary analysis and automated rollback. Chains deployment pipeline generation, observability setup, and rollback strategy into a single deploy-observe-revert workflow.
workflows.trigger: When deploying a change that requires canary analysis, staged rollout, and automated rollback triggers.

workflows.name: Document and Communicate
workflows.description: Capture completed work as clean, organized documentation (README and guides, development log, progress tracker, session history) with a consistency pass, then compile those artifacts into a single self-contained, offline, interactive HTML briefing to present and share.
workflows.trigger: After finishing a feature, milestone, or sprint, when the work needs to be both well-documented and ready to communicate to stakeholders or teammates.
